tools.name: tblock_pairs
tools.description: Lists the currencies a new block can be paired with at birth on TokenizedBlock (ETH, USDC, cbBTC, OUSD and Coinbase tokenized stocks), with the creator minimum floor of each, and in `echanges` the currency swaps tblock_plan_swap builds (both ways). Read-only, no input.

tools.name: tblock_creator_minimum
tools.description: Reads the creator minimum deposited for a block’s market (who deposited, how much, whether the 0.03% creator share is flowing) and, when `account` is that creator, returns the unsigned call for the next exit step: a request (the share stops at once), then, 7 days later, the withdrawal.

tools.name: tblock_panel_open
tools.description: Opens a remote-control session and returns the link of the TokenizedBlock control panel: a visual dashboard (the block in the centre; Market, Trade, Brain and Chat tabs) for the user to open in their browser with their wallet. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: tblock_panel_open, tblock_command · Private data: tblock_plan_birth, tblock_plan_swap, tblock_panel_open, tblock_command · Public sink: tblock_creator_minimum, tblock_panel_open, tblock_command.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: tblock_panel_open, tblock_command · Private data: tblock_plan_birth, tblock_plan_swap, tblock_panel_open, tblock_command · Public sink: tblock_creator_minimum, tblock_panel_open, tblock_command

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
